snippet.title: Here's a little teaser of NUKO!  An apocalyptic bunker building game show!
snippet.description:
Nuko is a game where you play a gameshow themed card game to earn credits to build a bunker to survive the apocolypse. Yes, that's the game! It's easy, it's fun, it's rewarding! More teasers coming soon!

"Happy Happy Game Show" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com)
#gameshow #paxaus #indiegame
